title: wg: draft-mahy-oob-aad-00 is a skeleton (for when it is revised)
description: From assay mimid-1wgh.44.15 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-oob-aad-00.txt. Not worth posting until -01.
